thread:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — SI partner Orion wants an end-to-end PoC: Gateways + LangChain/LlamaIndex + Redwood Private running on their on-prem cluster. Goal: validate integration, perf on partner HW, marketplace listing, and a joint announcement. Tentative launch window Apr 8-12. Who can take which bits?

Lars Henriksen: I can own the gateway adapter and compatibility checklist. Need the gateway API contract and the routing fallback policy. Is Orion on A100 or mixed GPUs?

Samir Patel: Orion is on DGX A100s for prod, but pilot infra includes some T4s and Ampere nodes. Hardware partner (NvidiaEdge) also wants perf numbers for seqlen=2048 workloads.

Jordan Lee: I'll produce LangChain + LlamaIndex sample apps and an orchestrator example that uses our HTTP adapter. Plan to include streaming and function-calling examples. Quick snippet I'll start with: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD")
resp = client.generate("Summarize the invoice")
print(resp.text)
```

Nina Gomez: Marketing ask — we need a co-marketing 1-pager, approved logo usage, and a joint customer quote by Mar 28 to hit the Apr window. Who will draft the copy and own legal sign-off?

Priya Nair: I will draft the announcement copy and own coordination w/ Orion. @Ava Chen can you confirm marketplace SKU and billing requirements? Also @Lars will you put the adapter spec in the runbook?

Ava Chen: Finance note: Marketplace needs a SKU + pricing tier. For Dedicated we need a reserved capacity SKU and a metered hosted fallback SKU. I'll confirm tolerances and cutover billing by 03/24.

Lars Henriksen: Will add adapter spec and a simple config example to runbook. Also need to validate routing policy: prefer private -> dedicated -> hosted for bursts. Can the orchestrator surface that policy via YAML?

Jordan Lee: Yes, we can expose routing policy in the orchestrator YAML. I'll include a sample config and a small E2E test that simulates burst fallback.

DevBot: runbook scaffold created: /runbooks/partners/orion-onramp-1725523456 — status: created. CI job: partners/poc-e2e triggered (artifact id: partners-e2e-1725).

Samir Patel: Action on hardware: I'll deliver perf matrix for A100 fp16, A100 int8, and T4 8-bit quant by 03/18. Will include latency p50/p95, throughput (tokens/s), and mem footprint for seqlen 512/2048.

Priya Nair: Action roundup (owners + dates):
- Lars: gateway adapter + runbook entry — due 03/22
- Jordan: LangChain/LlamaIndex samples + E2E test — due 03/20
- Samir: perf matrix + hardware artifacts — due 03/18
- Ava: marketplace SKU & billing confirmation — due 03/24
- Nina: marketing assets request list (logo rules, 1-pager template) — due 03/28
- Priya: announcement draft + PR plan — due 04/01

Jordan Lee: Acked, will post sample repo link in #devex and attach smoke-test results.

Lars Henriksen: One technical question — do we need to support a gateway shim for older orchestrators? If yes, we should add a compatibility adapter (minor API surface) to avoid breaking customers.

Jordan Lee: Recommend a small shim layer in the adapter that translates legacy calls to the new orchestration contract. I can prototype.

Nina Gomez: Marketing timeline: request all final approved logos and legal text by Mar 28, embargo date Apr 8, preferred pub Apr 9. If legal delays, fallback window Apr 10-12.

Priya Nair: Noted. I'll ping Orion legal and @Ava for marketplace contract sync. We'll reconvene next Tue for a status update. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll upload initial hardware logs and sample perf scripts to the runbook by EOD tomorrow.

DevBot: Reminder: schedule next sync created on 2024-03-19 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.

Priya Nair: Perfect, closing this thread — I'll circulate the consolidated action tracker after the meeting.
